thread:
emma: Quick thread to lock pilot scope for Optimize toolkit recommendations (batching, caching, quant) + eval alerts. Need minimal viable surface for customers.

noah: Sounds good. Prioritize read-only recommendations first. No autopilot.

maya: Agreed. Deliverables v1: console cards, recommendations API (read-only), CSV export for audits.

sam: Safety gating: require eval monitor attached before any rec is surfaced. If eval drift > threshold, hide recs.

emma: Threshold suggestions?

maya: Propose quality delta <= 2% on our eval set; latency p95 increase <= 25ms; expected cost savings >= 10% for workloads > 1M tokens/month.

noah: Also whitelist allowed precisions per model. e.g., core-7b -> int8 allowed, int4 blocked in v1.

ops-bot: Created task PROD-20111 for pilot infra and EXP-7510 for invited A/B test.

sam: Pilot rollout phases: internal sandbox -> invited 3 customers (2 hosted, 1 dedicated) -> public read-only. Autopilot deferred.

emma: Action items: @maya perf targets doc, @sam eval thresholds and alert definitions, @noah infra task owner. Target pilot start in 10 days if all green.

noah: I'll scope infra and post tickets.

emma: Thanks all. Keep comms here and flag blockers.
_meta: synthetic slack thread about Optimize toolkit pilot scope and launch criteria
